summary: Iter32 — Redesigned 'Post a Job' v31 (daily_worker vs contractor split + skills_required + site_stay + address fields). Backend: 6/6 pytest tests PASSED covering (a) Client posting full Daily Worker payload with skills_required=[{Full Trained,2},{Helper,3}], site_stay_allowed=true, address/city/state/pin_code, lat/lng, and verifying persistence via GET /api/jobs/{id}; (b) Client posting Contractor payload without skills_required/site_stay_allowed (200, daily_wage defaults to 0); (c) Backward-compat post with only title/description/skill/location succeeds (200); (d) Worker (9000000002) posting is correctly 403; (e) GET /api/jobs regression returns list including newly posted jobs; (f) Contractor role (9000000003) can also post. Frontend: end-to-end verified on mobile viewport 390x844 for Client (9000000001). All 16 required testIDs present: site-type-residential, site-type-commercial, worker-type-daily_worker, worker-type-contractor, job-title-dd, skill-cat-full-trained, skill-cat-semi-trained, skill-cat-helper, skill-cat-site-supervisor, sk-inc-full-trained, sk-dec-full-trained, desc-input, working-start-date, drawing-upload, site-stay-yes, site-stay-no, address-input, city-input, state-input, pin-input, capture-gps, post-job-submit. Before Worker Type selection: only Site Type + Worker Type cards + helper 'Select a Worker Type to continue.' visible; post-job-submit is HIDDEN (count=0). Selecting Daily Wages Worker reveals full form; NO wage input rendered (the 'Daily Wage' substring hit came from the 'Daily Wages Worker' card label — not a real field). Contractor mode correctly hides Skills Required + Site Stay while keeping Job Title/Description/Start Date/Drawing/Location. Validation: submitting empty on Daily Worker → 'Please select a Job Title' shown. Full flow: filled Mason as Job Title, Tomorrow via quick chip, Full Trained skill, Site Stay Yes, address/city/state/pin → 'Job posted ✓' rendered and router replaced to /(tabs)/activity — new job appeared in Home/My Jobs list. Worker (9000000002) → /post shows 'Not available — Only Client & Contractor accounts can post jobs.'

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — pre-existing across the app (not introduced by post.tsx). Non-blocking. Reference: various styles across /app/frontend/src/**
Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — pre-existing library warning (react-native-web). Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: post.tsx (635 lines) is close to the 700-line soft cap. Sub-components (SectionCard, SegmentBtn) and SKILL_CATEGORIES constant are well-scoped; further splitting is optional.
post.tsx sends both `skill: jobTitle` and `title: jobTitle` — good backward compat with legacy JobIn.skill filter used by /api/jobs and /api/jobs/search.
Validation ordering in submit() checks siteType → workerType → jobTitle → description → workingStartDate → address → dailyWorker-specific (skills, siteStay). Matches spec.

DatePickerField uses HTML `<input type="date">` on web via react-native-web escape hatch — quick chips (Today/Tomorrow/+3/+1w) work and set ISO YYYY-MM-DD. testID `working-start-date-quick-{offset}` is exposed for automation.
drawing_url is stored as base64 data URL — could be very large for high-res photos; consider a server-side size limit similar to MAX_PHOTO_B64_LEN (already exists for profile photos).
seed_data_creation: Tests inserted TEST_-prefixed jobs (TEST_Full Trained Mason, TEST_Plumber, TEST_Legacy Job, TEST_Contractor_Post) plus one UI-submitted job (Mason, TEST Bandra East, Mumbai). Left in DB for main-agent verification; can be cleaned via db.jobs.deleteMany({title: /^TEST/}) if desired.
